Subject: Post-discovery recap & next step: platform runthrough (60–90m)

Hi Andrew / GlowFin team —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed next step to keep momentum: 

Key takeaways
- Primary use case: low-latency query expansion and document summarization for customer support (short-form completions, < 512 tokens).
- Data residency constraint: US-only production datasets, limited S3 access patterns.
- SLOs: 95th pct latency target ~150ms for single-turn queries; peak traffic expected during business hours.
- Security: interested in Private deployment + KMS integration; procurement will need SOC2 and data flow diagrams.

Next step
We recommend a technical runthrough (60–90 minutes) with our ML/Infra and Solutions team so we can:
1) validate architecture and network constraints,
2) demo model variants and quantization options that fit your cost/latency targets,
3) align on rollout plan and prerequisites for a pilot.

Please confirm who from your side would attend (engineering, infra, procurement). I've attached a short discovery notes PDF and a one-page suggested agenda. Proposed windows next week (all PT):
- Tue 2027-08-30 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2027-08-31 14:00–15:30

If neither works, tell us two slots that do and we'll lock it.

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (summary of today's call)

Thanks,

— Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0193
https://redwood.com

---
Note: if GlowFin needs an on-prem/private packaging conversation, I'll loop Markus (ML infra) and Priyom (solutions) into the deep dive.
